classification: Source-backed terms and explicit conditional proxies. No historical source capture is changed.

implementationChoices.AAOI: Fresh or explicitly loaded research uses the normalized staged capacity adapter, including the (1+g) terminal-timing factor, with the existing initial sales/capital scalar0.8. The same adapter is used in every Monte Carlo draw. Existing saved linear paths remain unchanged until the user switches or loads research. The original linear stress and the earlier staged illustration in this evidence record are not the fresh app default. Default claims use the disclosed convertible fair-value proxy, separate vendor financing and a full-cap intrinsic warrant proxy. The optional known-transaction pro forma deducts the known September property cash purchase; all remaining cash movements remain user assumptions.
implementationChoices.GOOG: Reported first preferred dividend 12.15; nominal 15th payment dates; actual days / 365.25; default 6.25% independent discount assumption; full maximum-dilution ownership proxy, dividends retained. Noncurrent investments use gross carrying value; no separate realization-tax adjustment.
implementationChoices.limits: Neither model is a complete security fair-value appraisal. Selected claim inputs stay fixed in Monte Carlo; the AAOI intrinsic allocation is recalculated for every scenario.
implementationChoices.zeroMargin: The staged profile requires a positive mature margin to derive finite terminal-consistent capital productivity. Invalid baseline inputs withhold results; invalid sampled draws are excluded without replacement and counted.

AAOI.purpose: Evidence and conditional modeling contract for current-company valuation; preserve raw filings and historical freezes. All forecasts below are analyst assumptions, not issuer guidance or calibrated probabilities.

results.title: Issuer Q2 2026 results and Q3 outlook

convertibleTerms.earlyConversion: Prior to unrestricted date, only specified stock-price, note-trading-price or event conditions; a modeled intrinsic price alone is not proof of current legal convertibility.
convertibleTerms.settlementSource: Indenture 5.03: physical settlement delivers conversion-rate shares; cash/combination settlement uses 40-trading-day observation period.
convertibleTerms.redemptionCondition: 20 of preceding 30 trading days plus notice-preceding trading day; make-whole adjustments may increase shares.

cappedCalls.status: No capped-call offset identified in reviewed annual/quarterly notes or issuance indenture.

vendorTreatment.classification: Financing claim; issuer cash-flow presentation separately includes bank acceptance proceeds and repayments under financing activities.
vendorTreatment.consistency: Sales-to-capital reinvestment must be defined before this financing. Do not also reduce operating working capital by the same acceptance liability. If reclassified as operating supplier funding, revise reinvestment consistently rather than only deleting debt.
vendorTreatment.restrictedCashPolicy: Exclude separately disclosed restricted cash from unrestricted cash; no unsupported offset of restricted collateral.

default.label: Dated disclosed-market-claim bridge
default.formula: Common residual = DCF enterprise value + same-date unrestricted cash - bank debt - vendor financing - disclosed fair value of entire convertible instrument - other separately reviewed claims. Apply warrants separately.
default.denominator: Same-date common outstanding, 74.998m or 84.386m, rounded as filed. Do not add convertible shares.
default.notCurrent: June 30, 2026 note fair value is not an October 17 quote. It includes market-priced conversion optionality and depends on market stock prices, rates and credit. This conservative hybrid bridge is not a self-consistent intrinsic option valuation.
default.bookValueRule: Replace the book convertible amount with disclosed fair value; do not subtract both.

ifConverted.label: All-share settlement sensitivity; hypothetical, excludes option time value
ifConverted.formula: Remove the whole convertible claim, then add principalMillions * conversionRate / 1000 to common shares. No new cash is received on debt conversion.
ifConverted.selectionCaution: Do not automatically assume holders exchange a principal claim for shares worth less than principal. A below-strike if-converted outcome is a hypothetical settlement scenario, not a rational-holder default.
ifConverted.intrinsicSettlementAlternative: Ignoring time value and legal timing, common price solves value available before notes = basicShares * price + max(notePrincipal, conversionShares * price). Equivalent to lower of principal-subtraction and all-share-conversion values before floor and other option claims.

principalOnly.label: Principal-only sensitivity; not option-inclusive valuation
principalOnly.note: Principal is the contractual maturity amount; carrying amount includes issuance premium and unamortized costs. Neither captures the economic value of conversion optionality. Do not present either as fair value.

warrants.currentVestingCaution: The disclosed 1.324233m refers to vesting at issuance. H1 2026 cash-flow statement includes $1.775m of warrant issuance/vesting value without an exact updated vested-share roll-forward; do not label the initial amount as total current vested.
warrants.defaultScenario: Full contractual share cap, conditional on all vesting; conservative dilution scenario, not a claim that all shares have vested.
warrants.minimumScenario: Initially vested minimum count only; excludes later vesting and understates possible dilution.
warrants.intrinsicExerciseFormula: If pre-warrant equity / shares exceeds strike, price = (pre-warrant equity + strike * eligibleWarrantShares) / (shares + eligibleWarrantShares); otherwise use pre-warrant equity / shares. Floor negative equity at zero for common price.
warrants.exerciseProceedsRule: Add proceeds once only if adding gross exercise shares; alternatively solve net-share dilution without a proceeds addition.
limits: Intrinsic exercise ignores remaining time value and vesting/settlement details; it is not current warrant fair value.

Keep reported net-revenue and GAAP SBC baseline unchanged. Avoid adding a second blanket warrant-dollar claim on top of explicit warrant dilution. Future revenue reductions and future vesting can overlap economically; full-cap sensitivity is intentionally conservative.

employeeAwards.recommendedTreatment: Disclose explicitly as existing unvested award sensitivity; retain continuing GAAP SBC as an operating expense, avoid an unexplained generic dilution percentage on top. For maximum conservatism add 1.909m awards to denominator, label service/performance vesting assumption and possible overlap with future compensation deductions.

shareBasis.default: Original contemporaneous common-share basis; no stock-split adjustment identified in reviewed filings. Do not use weighted-average EPS shares or the 92.8m non-GAAP Q3 guidance denominator as actual outstanding shares.

subsequentEvents.shareCountCaution: Not a verified October outstanding count; excludes subsequent awards, conversions and other changes.
subsequentEvents.cashCaution: Do not call June cash plus net proceeds current cash. Q3 operating/investing use, debt changes, restricted balances and other transactions remain unreconciled.

subsequentEvents.scopeCaution: A known post-June cash use, not a complete cash roll-forward.

subsequentEvents.modelTreatment: Keep rent within future operating margin if leases are operating; do not also capitalize/deduct all lease debt without corresponding operating adjustments.
Additional fixed operating commitment; not converted to guessed USD.

operatingEvidence.capitalAssetPolicy: These are operating assets already in the enterprise. Do not add them to cash/equity or charge the same prepaid amount a second time when placed into service. Future capex still needs funding.

conditionalOperatingPath.label: Capital-intensive staged turnaround illustration
conditionalOperatingPath.status: Initial unnormalized illustration; superseded for implementation by normalizedStagedAdapter, which preserves four editable inputs and adds an exact terminal-consistent capital fade.
rationale: Front-load growth to reflect the stated near-term ramp, then slow growth substantially rather than perpetuating 60% for years.
Move margin to zero in year 2 and 12% in year 6 only as conditional operating leverage; non-GAAP net profit is not GAAP EBIT.
Improve sales-to-capital from 0.8 to 1.6 as utilization improves; this is an assumption, not a measured marginal ratio.
No observed share price or desired price target was used to select the path. A zero common residual remains a legitimate conditional result.

diagnostic.fundingCaution: FCFF deficit is an operating-funding diagnostic, not a complete liquidity waterfall: excludes debt service, required cash buffer, timing within years and financing costs. Existing cash is not both added to value and removed from FCFF; it is shown separately for financing feasibility.

displayRules: Show enterprise value and negative residual separately from the limited-liability common floor of $0.
A zero DCF residual does not mean the traded stock or abandonment/turnaround option has literally zero value.
Show peak cumulative negative FCFF and financing shortfall; no assumption that new equity can be raised without dilution.
Do not add new-financing cash without adding new shares, and do not subtract financing proceeds from FCFF.
A staged illustration is more informative than the old nine-negative-year smooth fade, but remains conditional rather than fully financed.

normalizedStagedAdapter.status: Recommended source-reasoned analyst shape; no market-price calibration
normalizedStagedAdapter.growthFormula: yearGrowth = terminalGrowth + (sampledGrowth - terminalGrowth) * growthWeight; first year equals sampled growth; last year equals stable growth.
normalizedStagedAdapter.marginFormula: yearMargin = actualAdjustedStartingMargin + (sampledTargetMargin - actualAdjustedStartingMargin) * marginWeight; from year 6 equals sampled target. Weights are fixed, computed once from reference TTM margin and the chosen illustration, not recomputed to erase sampled target uncertainty.
normalizedStagedAdapter.capitalDriverMeaning: Initial incremental sales/capital; 0.8x baseline. Early-stage utilization raises it toward 2 times input in years 6–7.
normalizedStagedAdapter.lateCapitalFormula: inverseSalesCapital = (1 - fadeWeight) / (2 * sampledSalesCapital) + fadeWeight * terminalCapitalIntensity; salesCapital = 1 / inverseSalesCapital.
normalizedStagedAdapter.terminalConsistencyProof: With constant final growth g and margin m, explicit reinvestment = (R_t - R_t-1) * (1+g)*m*(1-tax)/ROIC = NOPAT_t*g/ROIC. Thus final FCFF*(1+g) equals terminal-year NOPAT*(1-g/ROIC). The (1+g) factor matches the existing engine contemporaneous delta-sales convention to its terminal g/ROIC convention.
normalizedStagedAdapter.discounting: Use sampled WACC each year and same terminal WACC; taxes fixed unless user changes the scalar tax rate.
normalizedStagedAdapter.controls: Keep scalar assumptions editable, derive overrides inside the shared current valuation path. Do not persist generated arrays as user-authored overrides. Every Monte Carlo draw must run the same adapter.
normalizedStagedAdapter.zeroMarginBoundary: When targetMargin=0, terminal intensity is zero. If the existing engine requires a finite positive salesCapital override, use Number.MAX_VALUE as a documented numerical limiting representation instead of Infinity; its resulting investment is negligible at monetary precision. Deterministic and simulation must share the same convention.
rationale: The issuer reported Q2 2026 revenue of $191.9m and guided Q3 to $255–290m. A front-loaded growth path with a fast decline from 60% to 40%, 30% and 20% is a bounded analyst illustration of ramp then slowdown, not a forecast derived directly from units or guidance.

Management described approximate 200,000 monthly capacity and an expected 650,000 by year-end 2026. Capacity is not recognized revenue or guaranteed utilization; no direct multiplication of capacity by an invented selling price is used.

The initial margin is reported GAAP TTM EBIT/revenue. Conditional break-even by year 2 and 12% mature margin by year 6 are analyst operating-leverage judgments; non-GAAP net income is not substituted for GAAP EBIT.

Initial 0.8x sales/capital remains a conservative capital-heavy input; the temporary twofold utilization improvement is assumed, motivated by already funded construction and equipment prepayments, not by a verified incremental asset-turnover ratio.

Capital intensity subsequently converges to the independently specified mature marginal ROIC, allowing competitive erosion of the higher mid-ramp return and eliminating a mechanical terminal reinvestment jump.
All forecast growth, margin, capital-efficiency and risk values remain editable or sampled. The fixed weights describe transition shape, not independent reported facts or probabilities.
normalizedStagedAdapter.defaultOutputInterpretation: The shared staged default still has negative operating enterprise value and common residual; show both raw residual and limited-liability floor, plus funding needs. It does not price abandonment, future funding access, default, recovery or an option to change strategy.

GOOG.units: USD millions and shares millions except explicitly per-share terms
GOOG.classification: Primary-source terms plus explicit analyst bridge scenarios; not a security fair-value appraisal or current quote
GOOG.historicalFreezePolicy: No change to historical source files, hashes, dates, or forecasts. June 2026 instrument is never backfilled into December 2025.

reportedAmounts.reconciliation: 19034 - 1011 = 18023. Cash-flow proceeds differ from equity issuance presentation by 29; do not silently force equality or invent the reason.

commonSharesJune30.precision: Rounded to millions. July 15 cover counts coincidentally equal these June 30 balance-sheet counts.

securityTerms.priority: Senior to all three common classes; A and B rank equally; junior to indebtedness and any future senior stock. Liquidation preference plus accumulated unpaid dividends. No participation in residual assets after payment.
securityTerms.redemption: No issuer redemption or sinking fund. Ordinary holder early conversion uses the minimum rate, subject to adjustments.
securityTerms.voting: Preferred generally nonvoting, with protective/nonpayment exceptions. Common A has 1 vote, B 10 votes, C no vote except legally required. A/B/C economic dividend and liquidation rights are otherwise equal. Valuation does not price voting premiums.
securityTerms.mandatoryConversionDateRule: Second business day after the last trading day of the final averaging period; date can shift under contractual market-disruption rules.
securityTerms.applicableMarketValueRule: Arithmetic average of daily VWAP over 20 consecutive trading days beginning with the 21st scheduled trading day immediately preceding May 15, 2029. Each class uses its own future average.
securityTerms.conversionFormula: Below initial price: maximum rate. From initial price through threshold: 1000 / applicable future class VWAP, rounded to 4 decimal places. Above threshold: minimum rate. Subject to anti-dilution and dividend additions.
securityTerms.fundamentalChanges: Certificates grant a holder fundamental-change conversion election with special rates and potentially dividend make-whole; these are outside the ordinary mandatory-conversion model. Do not treat the abbreviated 10-Q description as a complete legal payoff.
securityTerms.adjustmentsExcluded: Stock splits, extraordinary distributions, anti-dilution adjustments, early/fundamental-change conversion, default, and extra common shares for unpaid dividends.

preferredDividendModel.firstAmountPrecision: Model uses the July declaration as rounded in the 10-Q. Prospectuses provide the expected initial stub at approximately 12.1528. Using 12.1528 changes undiscounted aggregate dividends by only 0.0539 million. Neither source establishes subsequent actual payment in this review.
preferredDividendModel.recordDates: First day of February, May, August and November.
preferredDividendModel.paymentDateRule: Nominal 15th; actual payment rolls to the next New York bank business day if needed, without extra interest.
preferredDividendModel.stockSettlementRule: Issuer may deliver common shares at 97% of the relevant five-trading-day average price, subject to a floor and possible cash shortfall; unpaid dividends can add conversion shares. Cash settlement default does not cover this extra dilution.
preferredDividendModel.paymentTimingApproximation: Uses nominal quarterly dates. Does not price the small next-business-day settlement delay.
preferredDividendModel.discountRateClassification: Analyst assumption chosen for a transparent coupon-rate reference; NOT observed yield, fair-value rate, tax-adjusted WACC, or the contractual fundamental-change make-whole discount rate.
preferredDividendModel.accrualTreatment: The full initial future payment already includes the June 30 accumulated amount. Do not subtract the reported 86 again in conversion mode. Preferred dividends are financing distributions, not deductions from operating EBIT or FCFF.

cappedCalls.coveredSharesBasis: Common shares underlying the preferred at minimum conversion rates.
cappedCalls.defaultTreatment: No future capped-call asset or share offset is assumed; historical premium is already in June cash/equity and is never charged again. Zero future recovery is a conservative scenario assumption, not a finding that the options have no value.
cappedCalls.settlement: Issuer can elect cash settlement; otherwise generally common shares based on excess over strike, limited by cap. Counterparty risk applies.
cappedCalls.sensitivityFormulaOnly: At an explicitly assumed common future settlement price P, gross economic share offset approximation = minimum underlying shares * max(0, min(P, cap) - strike) / P. This ignores detailed averaging and adjustments; do not present it as observed option fair value.

recommendedBridge.baseEquation: E = EV + reported cash/current marketables + analyst other-asset values - reported debt - finance leases - NCI value - additional non-preferred claims. v = (E - preferred-dividend PV) / (12230 + incremental preferred conversion shares).
recommendedBridge.timingRationale: Conversion occurs inside the ten-year forecast. A static fully diluted denominator allocates all residual present equity to eventual shares, with no separately modeled preconversion common payouts. It is a transparent approximation to actual timed conversion, not an exact preferred fair-value calculation. Do not discount the number of conversion shares.
recommendedBridge.timingRefinement: If A is the present value of total common distributions before conversion, a consistent payout refinement is A/12230 + (E - dividendPV - A)/(12230 + q), holding other capital structure assumptions fixed. The default assumes A=0 for this allocation; it does not predict Alphabet will cease common dividends.
recommendedBridge.maxDilutionCaveat: Maximum contractual gross shares gives the lower positive value only with other inputs held fixed, cash-paid preferred dividends, unchanged conversion terms, and no cap-call recovery. It is not a universal economic lower bound.

conversionSensitivity.formulaDriven: Requires separately labeled future Class A and Class C VWAP assumptions, never substitutes current GOOG quote for both.

alternativeModes.label: Liquidation preference plus rounded accumulated dividends; not current market/fair value and not a complete liquidation appraisal of operating assets. Future preferred dividends do not survive liquidation.

alternativeModes.formula: 192.5m GOOGM depositaries * USD market price + 192.5m GOOGN depositaries * USD market price, with consistent clean/dirty dividend convention; or an explicitly labeled analyst total claim value.
requiredInputs: Date matching valuation balance basis, or an explicit complete roll-forward
Verified sources and depositary unit basis for both securities
Dividend entitlement and ex-dividend/dirty price convention
alternativeModes.capCallAsset: Value separately if verified; never deduct the historical premium again.
alternativeModes.warning: An entire preferred fair-value claim includes conversion rights and dividend rights; subtracting additional conversion dilution or the whole dividend PV would double-count.

recommendedBridge.investmentTreatment: Current cash bridge already includes 87063 of marketable equity. Noncurrent investments 145587 may be added as an explicitly selected gross carrying-value proxy with separate editable haircuts. Neither their full book value nor a zero haircut is a fair-value conclusion.
recommendedBridge.investmentTaxes: Gross asset proxy has no implied realization-tax allowance. Add an explicit analyst tax reserve if used. Total reported deferred tax liabilities 22819 cannot be assigned wholesale to these investments without evidence.
recommendedBridge.operatingLeaseTreatment: Keep operating lease expense in forecast operating profit; do not mechanically add operating lease liabilities as debt without restating operating profit and reinvestment consistently.
recommendedBridge.otherAwards: Quarterly weighted-average diluted EPS shares already include some preferred conversion effects and cannot be combined with full preferred conversion shares. Use actual June common count; existing employee awards require their own separately documented treatment.
recommendedBridge.numericPrecision: Retain calculation precision internally, but display valuation in sensible rounded dollars, not as exact security fair value. NCI/common counts and some dividends are rounded filing facts.

subsequentEvents.treatment: Known later financing is excluded from the June 30 balance-date valuation. Do not add only the new debt while retaining June cash; a current October value requires a complete cash/debt/capex and security roll-forward.
subsequentEvents.researchScope: Checked the available current SEC submissions listing and the August 10 closing 8-K. This is not a certification of every change through October 17 or a current quote.

doubleCountingChecks: Never subtract preferred carrying balance or liquidation principal in conversion mode.
Never add full preferred dilution to an entire market-valued preferred claim deduction.
Never add June preferred financing proceeds or charge June capped-call premium again.
Never add RNCI 824 separately from NCI 7100.
Never add current marketable equity 87063 again; it is within cash/current marketables 242474.
Never combine aggregate diluted EPS shares with full conversion shares.
Do not add all reported deferred taxes or operating lease debt mechanically.
limitations: No current GOOG, GOOGL, GOOGM or GOOGN quote was used or fabricated.
These scenarios resolve the mandatory preferred mechanics sufficiently for a conditional educational valuation; they do not certify complete fair market value.
Valuation uses June 30 balances and a forward forecast; October review date is not an October balance-sheet measurement.
Potential taxation, security restrictions, employee awards and uncommenced infrastructure commitments remain explicit modeling limitations.
